status: design-only; not an installable plugin manifest

existing_package_evidence.preservation: No source, ZIP, report body, template routing file, or generated artifact in the RC package was modified. Existing report owner remains sole writer of the renderer and canonical report assets.

product_scope.user_runtime: user-owned ChatGPT desktop Work project and user environment; no MoAI analysis server

pro.account_read: separately consented user-local only; not implemented in this vertical slice

component_responsibilities.goose_entry_skill: one installed coordinator skill; route user intent to only the necessary leaf workflow and produce an execution record
component_responsibilities.workflow_guides: local guidance modules; not independently installed tools and not proof of host-native child agents
component_responsibilities.specialist_roles: use host-native child-agent APIs only if the active ChatGPT Work host actually exposes them; otherwise execute sequentially and record execution_mode=sequential
component_responsibilities.mcp_server: read and normalize only allowlisted typed provider facts; never write a report, store account data, choose a security, calculate a valuation, or execute an action
component_responsibilities.report_generator: existing report owner consumes a versioned normalized evidence package and remains sole writer of HTML renderer, template schema and canonical report assets
component_responsibilities.local_storage: user-approved project-local reports/data/history locations; no MoAI upload; no secrets in .goose, report files or general logs

runtime_contract.report_contract_ref: atp-report/2.0-review (existing RC schema; subject to report owner change)
runtime_contract.transport: user-local stdio only in prototype; ChatGPT Work host launch is unverified
mcp_constraints: no raw KIS payload in tool arguments
no account identifier or credential in model-visible arguments

goose_execution_record.source_of_truth: record only observed host execution; do not infer child agents from skill names or write a simulated child ID
goose_execution_record.sequential_fallback: if the host lacks native child-agent support, the Goose coordinator executes the approved specialist procedures sequentially and labels the run accordingly

goose_workflow.behavior: explain natural-language Goose setup; do not promise a slash command unless the host confirms it; collect only optional profile preferences; never accept KIS secrets or account number
classify common investor question, market, asset, requested report depth, cutoff and permitted source scope; ask only for ambiguous instrument/goal required to change output
check tier, local consent, provider/exchange rights, account scope and tool availability before any provider call; fail closed if unresolved
call only the selected typed MCP operation(s); preserve raw provider response inside local adapter; expose only bounded normalized fields and lineage
specialists consume the same versioned evidence package; keep facts, estimates, inferences, missing fields, counter-evidence and cutoff distinct; deterministic calculations are separate and versioned
send a validated report-input contract to the report owner’s existing HTML generator; do not fill missing required fields with synthetic values
run schema, provenance, rights, security/share, factual, calculation and render checks; status stays draft/limited if required evidence or visual checks are missing
write only into the user-approved local reports/<run_id>/ location; preserve source ledger, normalized input and validation record; never upload personal financial files to MoAI or Library

first_report_integration_gate.candidate_family_label: R01 심층 from earlier read-only master-plan review only
first_report_integration_gate.current_deep_template_id: deep (verified only in the existing 0.3.0-rc.1 routing manifest)
first_report_integration_gate.reason: The existing deep schema also requires a bounded multi-point price_history and independent company, financial, thesis, business-mix, risk, scenario, source and claim inputs. One quote snapshot cannot satisfy those requirements.

current_adapter_mapping.source_record: one KIS quote source with sample mapping, date-only source_as_of, local received/available time and per-field lineage
current_adapter_mapping.price_history: not mapped by the currently exposed tool; do not duplicate one snapshot into a multi-point series
current_adapter_mapping.company_financials: must come from direct DART/SEC sources and carry period, scope, unit and revision lineage; not implemented here
current_adapter_mapping.theses_scenarios_risks: must be evidence-linked analysis inputs; not inferred from the quote

blockers_before_real_render: No current KIS credential profile or active provider connection is configured in this isolated prototype.
Market-data and exchange display/storage/derived-use permissions are not documented as cleared; current runtime default-denies live access.
KIS current portal schema and account-specific throttles have not been independently validated.
The active ChatGPT Work host has not been shown to launch this local stdio process or expose its tool.
The complete report input and report-owner generator path are separate from this one-tool MCP slice.
first_report_integration_gate.no_fabrication_rule: Do not produce or label a full verified-source report from the synthetic fixture or quote snapshot alone. No live KIS call or financial report was performed in this task.

distribution_security.free_source_license: AGPLv3 approved direction for the future public free package; does not retroactively change the inspected RC metadata and does not grant market-data rights
distribution_security.pro_distribution: private student ZIP direction; separate code and content boundary; preserve third-party notices
distribution_security.secret_policy: .goose stores configuration and non-secret license references; recommend OS secure store for KIS credentials; no key/token/account identifier in this contract or any plugin manifest
distribution_security.rights_policy: code license, provider data rights, host/model processing and user-local storage are separate gates
